items.title: The Chronicler - Obtain every base-game trophy.
Awoken - Rise from your reverie.
With Great Power - Inherit a power unknown.
Acceptance - Accept your fate.
Lawless - Defy your fate.
Legacy - Turn the corner.
Twilight Rose - Revisit the past.
From Stone to Sand - Exact revenge.
Twin Flames - Unite the flames.
The Promise - Become one.
A Vessel Complete - Collect the final piece.
Ashes to Ashes - Escape the Darkness.
Falling Star - Fulfill a legacy.
Punisher - Punish 10 enemies outside the Hall of Virtue.
You're Not the Boss of Me - Defeat a boss without taking damage.
Made to Be Broken - Defeat 20 enemies while semi-primed outside the Hall of Virtue.
It's Over 50,000 - Deal 50,000 damage to a staggered enemy outside excluded battle states.
Sheeeeeeeeeeeeeeeift - Land 15 Shift Strikes or Shift Shots outside the Hall of Virtue.
Packing Heat - Land 2 Heatwave Counters in one battle outside the Hall of Virtue.
Fatal Attraction - Defeat 5 airborne enemies after using Deadly Embrace outside the Hall of Virtue.
Never Coming Down - Land Gouge, Wicked Wheel, and Rook's Gambit in midair before landing.
I Am the Thunder - Discharge 50 Blind Justice lightning balls outside the Hall of Virtue.
Rod to Redemption - Lure an enemy into striking Lightning Rod 3 times before it dissipates.
Untouchable - Use Titanic Block to fend off 10 enemy attacks outside the Hall of Virtue.
Beat Rocking Blocks - Land the third Titanic Counter punch twice in one battle.
100 Mfps - Land 100 hits with level 2 or higher Megaflare outside the Hall of Virtue.
Such Dodge, So Mega - Precision Dodge 3 times while charging one Megaflare.
Oh, Snap! - Inflict Permafrost on 10 enemies with Cold Snap outside the Hall of Virtue.
Cold-blooded - Defeat 3 or more frozen enemies at the same time.
Every Damn Sinew - Land level 2 or higher Zantetsuken 5 times outside the Hall of Virtue.
Fistful of Steel - Execute 3 Steel Counters in one battle outside the Hall of Virtue.
Yes, Eikon - Master all abilities and feats for one Eikon.
Masterclass - Fully upgrade every feat and ability.
With Two Ds - Fully upgrade consumable potency and inventory slots.
And They Opened Up My Mind - Collect all six signboards.
Think, Mark! - Defeat 10 notorious marks.
Hunter, Hunted - Clear the Hunt Board.
Trial Run - Complete a chronolith trial.
For the Hoard - Obtain all curiosities.
Dressed to the Fives - Craft or upgrade 5 pieces of gear.
Half Past Twilight - Craft the legendary sword Gotterdammerung.
The Pen Is Mightier - Open 10 letters at the reading table.
The More You Know - Help Harpocrates reach knowledge level 5.
Careful Whisper - Obtain every available patron item.
You Can Pet the Dog - Pet Torgal 5 times.
A Fine Hound - Land 5 Precision Sics outside the Hall of Virtue.
When You Ride Alone - Ride Ambrosia for the first time.
Here Be Rosfields - Visit every area on the world and local maps.
Eureka - Spend 36,000 gil at the Tub & Crown.
Fantasy, Finally - Complete the game on Final Fantasy mode.
A Crystal Darkly - Brave the dusk.
The Only Way Is Up - Enter the spire.
Repercussion - Silence the echoes.
OMG - Defeat Omega on Final Fantasy mode.
Bit Fit - Obtain all Fallen bits.
My Reward Is with Me - Obtain the Omega Weapon.
The Calm - Find again what was lost.
Homecoming - Enter Mysidia.
Flow - Awaken the storm.
Flood - Restore the flow of time.
Explain That - Tame the tides.
Thou Brakest the Head - Defeat Leviathan on Final Fantasy mode.
Tideslinger - Land 300 Tidal attacks outside the Hall of Virtue.
Supersoaker - Hit 3 or more enemies with Tidal attacks during unlimited ammunition after Quick Refill.
Deus Ex - Channel the heavens.
A Most Worthy Vessel - Acquire and master all Leviathan and Ultima abilities.
The End Can Wait - Complete 10 Mysidian quests.
Still Breathing - Complete the Trial by Water.
Occasio Calva - Complete Kairos Gate.
